nodes.label: AI Website Cloner Template
nodes.rationale: Reusable template for reverse-engineering any website into a clean, modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents. Point at a URL, run /clone-website, and the agent inspects, extracts design tokens and assets, writes component specs, and dispatches parallel builders.

nodes.label: /clone-website skill
nodes.rationale: Multi-phase pipeline: Reconnaissance, Foundation, Component Specs, Parallel Build, Assembly & QA. Each builder agent receives full component specification inline with exact getComputedStyle() values, interaction models, and responsive breakpoints.

nodes.label: Parallel Builder Pattern
nodes.rationale: Dispatches builder agents in git worktrees, one per section/component, to reconstruct every section in parallel. Each builder receives full component specification inline — no guessing.

nodes.label: Visual Audit
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 of website inspection: screenshots of every page at multiple viewports, dark/light variants, interaction states, loading states, empty states, error states, plus extraction of colors, typography, spacing, border radius, shadows, breakpoints, icons, avatars, buttons, inputs.

nodes.label: Component Inventory
nodes.rationale: Phase 2 of website inspection: for each distinct UI component document name, structure, variants, states, responsive behavior, interactions, and animations.

nodes.label: Layout Architecture
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 of website inspection: grid system, column layout, max-width, sticky elements, z-index layers, scroll behavior.

nodes.label: Tech Stack Analysis
nodes.rationale: Phase 4 of website inspection: detect framework, CSS approach, state management, API patterns, font loading, image strategy, animation library.

nodes.label: Five-Phase Inspection Methodology
nodes.rationale: Systematic five-phase approach: Visual Audit, Component Inventory, Layout Architecture, Technical Stack Analysis, Documentation Output. Ensures comprehensive extraction before building.

nodes.label: Navigation Float Transition
nodes.rationale: Triggered by scroll > 0. State A: transparent nav with alpha near 0. State B: floating pill with glass-morphism. Driven by CSS custom properties (--hero-nav-bg-alpha, --hero-nav-shadow-alpha, etc.) animated via JS scroll listener on [data-hero-nav-active] element.

nodes.label: Scroll-Driven Fade-in Animations
nodes.rationale: IntersectionObserver on each section/card. Offscreen: opacity 0, translateY(40px). In viewport: opacity 1, translateY(0). Transition: opacity 0.9s, transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1). Cards have staggered delays (0s, 0.08s, 0.16s).

nodes.label: Responsive Breakpoints
nodes.rationale: Desktop 1440px (full layout, 3-col cards, 2-col packages, 4-col footer), Tablet ~768px (hamburger nav, 2-col cards, reduced fonts, 2-col footer), Mobile 390px (single column, hamburger slide-out, smaller H1, full-width cards).

nodes.label: Page Section Order
nodes.rationale: 13 sections top-to-bottom: Navigation Bar (fixed z-50), Hero Section (#hero), Client Strip / Logo Marquee, Who We Are (#who), Our Work (#work), How We Work (#process), Gallery (#gallery), Packages (#packages), Testimonials, FAQ (#faq), Contact (#contact), Final CTA (#final-cta), Footer. Single-page site, dark mode, Geist font family.

nodes.label: Global Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Colors: bg black/near-black, text primary rgb(247,247,242) warm off-white, muted rgb(182,182,175). Typography: Geist font, H1 100.8px weight 760, H2 79.2px weight 850. Spacing: ~120px section padding, ~1200px max-width. Border radius: 30px cards, 15-16px buttons. Shadows: rgba(0,0,0,0.32) 0 24px 60px.

nodes.label: Design System Consistency
nodes.rationale: All 13 components share identical section padding (120px 72px), max-width (1440px), color palette (#f7f7f2, rgba(247,247,242,0.56), rgba(247,247,242,0.66)), and typography scale (79.2px h2, 28px h3, 16px body, 12-14px labels) to create a cohesive single-page experience on dark background (#030303).

nodes.label: Organic Content Branding Philosophy
nodes.rationale: The site emphasizes 'No Paid Media' and 'Audience before algorithm' as operating beliefs. All content and testimonials reinforce organic-only growth without paid advertising, building brand credibility around earned attention.
